evals.prompt: Perform a read-only health audit of evals/fixtures/stale-fallback. Use its existing Graphify graph first, verify findings in current source, and do not modify the fixture.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized audit that identifies the duplicate timeout configuration and broad silent fallback with exact evidence.
expectations: Uses the existing Graphify graph before broad source browsing
Identifies both timeout sources as a duplicate configuration contract
Identifies the broad exception fallback as hiding invalid input
Cites exact fixture files and line numbers

evals.prompt: Perform a read-only health audit of evals/fixtures/dynamic-registry. Investigate apparently unused helpers and use the existing Graphify graph for navigation.
evals.expected_output: An audit that traces decorator registration and keeps or defers the plugin instead of falsely declaring it dead.
expectations: Traces the decorator registration and PLUGINS lookup
Does not classify normalize as verified dead code
Classifies the plugin as Keep or explains equivalent evidence
Cites exact fixture files and line numbers

evals.prompt: Perform a read-only health audit of evals/fixtures/future-conflict. Check current code against repository standards and documented future plans, using its existing Graphify graph first.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized audit of the absolute path and divergent retry values, citing both source and planning evidence.
expectations: Identifies RETRY_COUNT and retry_count as divergent sources of truth
Cites ROADMAP.md and AGENTS.md as conflicting requirements
